units.source_text: 他仔细瞧了瞧女人的呼吸情况，然后退到门边，迅速从那儿跑出去。

en.t: He carefully watched how the woman was breathing, then backed away to the doorway and quickly ran out from there.

units.source_text: 他抓住灯和铁锹，立刻又返回里屋。

en.t: He grabbed the lamp and the shovel, then immediately went back into the inner room.

units.source_text: 女人的脸微微朝下横躺着，合着呼吸，下巴频繁地上上下下。

en.t: The woman's face lay turned slightly downward, and with each breath her chin kept moving up and down.

units.source_text: 吸气的时候，将下巴朝前冲出，那是为了避免把地席上的沙子一起吸进去吧。

en.t: When she breathed in, she thrust her chin forward, probably to keep from drawing in the sand on the mat along with the air.

units.source_text: 呼气的时候则相反，鼻翼颤动，像是为了吹散脸周围的沙子。

en.t: When she breathed out it was the opposite: her nostrils trembled as if she were trying to blow away the sand around her face.
